source_claim: Appland's official secondary-creation guideline explicitly names the characters whose rights the company holds, including the 12-member Idol Club group and Denno Shojo Siro, Merry Milk, and Rurun Rururica. The same campaign characters are enumerated as company-owned rights, and the official talent roster independently lists the active .LIVE members among this campaign.
notes: Appland's official license guideline states these are characters whose rights Appland holds and enumerates the 12 Idol Club characters by name, in addition to Denno Shojo Siro, Merry Milk, and Rurun Rururica: https://appland.co.jp/guideline/. It explicitly names all 13 campaign members using Japanese names (カルロ・ピノ, 電脳少女シロ, 花京院ちえり, 木曽あずき, 北上双葉, 金剛いろは, メリーミルク, もこ田めめめ, 猫乃木もち, ルルン・ルルリカ, 八重沢なとり, ヤマトイオリ, 夜桜たま). The official App Land talent directory independently confirms current members including Siro, Chieri, Pino, Mememe, Iori, and Rurun: https://appland.co.jp/talents/. The checked first-party rights roster explicitly includes former members as characters whose rights Appland holds; it supports their direct HOME under the exact in-catalog Copyright root `.live`, whose qualifier-to-root identity is already exact-reviewed in the Issue #180 v3 migrated evidence seed.
